title: Fiscal configs
description: Albanian CIS fiscalization and e-invoice settings (NIPT, TCR, certificates).

help.title: About Fiscal configs
help.overview: A fiscal config is the Albanian CIS identity used to sign a till receipt: NIPT, business unit, operator, software code, TCR, endpoints, and the signing certificate. A POS config points at one fiscal config. With none selected, that till does not fiscalize.

sections.title: When a sale is fiscalized
sections.body: After the till is paid, fiscalization runs when this config is active and a certificate is attached. A successful fiscal invoice is always followed by an e-invoice. The payment still completes if CIS returns a fault.
items: NIPT falls back to the company VAT when this field is empty. The TCR code must already be registered before an invoice can be signed.
The fiscal invoice is marked as an e-invoice and the UBL document is registered with CIS.
Test and production choose which CIS environment the URLs and certificate belong to.
The certificate is a PKCS#12 file. Leaving the password blank on edit keeps the stored password.
